compatibilityDescription: Generates the BatLabs-derived software key format. Not compatible with ASTRO 25 Portable CPS (including XTS5000), APX CPS, or Advanced System Keys (ASK).
inputDescription: Enter the ID of a legacy Motorola trunking system.
systemIdHelp: Use 1–4 hexadecimal digits (0–9, A–F). Short IDs are padded with leading zeros.
invalidSystemId: Enter 1–4 hexadecimal digits (0–9, A–F), without a 0x prefix.
emptyState: Enter a System ID to preview and download your .KEY file.
